content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Versioning is where release identity meets the product; the gate forces the version commitment to answer to one CLI for humans and agents alike. Its dependent's end is a version layer the matrix does not list, so the cell is the matrix default — the gate plus a flag to extend the matrix (the layer named for F1).
